items: Remember that DPSPs are non-justiciable, meaning they cannot be enforced by courts.
Frequently tested: The source of inspiration for Indian DPSPs is the Irish Constitution.
DPSPs play a crucial role in aiding the judiciary during the legal interpretation of statutes.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP) are non-justiciable in nature.
The primary goal of DPSPs is to promote the welfare of the people.
DPSPs address social, economic, and political issues across the nation.
The concept of DPSP was inspired by the Irish Constitution.
They serve as useful guidelines for the judiciary in the interpretation of laws.
